newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Lawrence County, Tenn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Lawrence County, Tenn..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that Lawrence County, Tennessee (the County'') will receive sealed bids for the purchase of the County's $10,000,000 School Bonds, Series 1996 (the Bonds''), on an all or none basis, until 11:00 a.m., Central Standard Time, on
at the County Executive's Office, Lawrence County
Courthouse, 1st Floor, 240 W. Gaines Street, Lawrenceburg, Tennessee 38464, at which time and place the sealed bids will be opened and announced.
The Bonds shall be dated November 1, 1996 and will mature on May 1 in the years 2001 through 2016, inclusively. The Bonds shall be issued in registered form, in the

denominations, bear interest payable at such times, mature in the amounts and bear such other details, as set forth in the Detailed Notice of Sale. No interest rate on the Bonds shall exceed eight percent (8%) per annum. The Bonds shall be designated as qualified tax-exempt obligations'' within the meaning and for the purpose of Section 265 of the United States Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. The Bonds are callable on May 1, 2004 and on any interest payment date thereafter, as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale.

Bidders must bid for all the Bonds, and no proposal for less than ninety-eight and three-quarters percent (98-3/4%) of the par amount and accrued interest to the date of delivery will be considered. The Bonds will be awarded on the sale date to the bidder whose bid complies with the Detailed Notice of Sale and results in the lowest net interest cost to the County. The successful bidder will be required to forward an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the par amount of the Bonds ($200,000), payable to the County as a guarantee of good faith, no later than the day following the sale date (as more fully described in the Detailed Notice of Sale).

The Bonds shall be payable from and secured by a pledge of certain sales tax revenues of the County (as more fully described in the Detailed Notice of Sale). In the event of a deficiency in said sales tax revenues, the Bonds shall be payable from unlimited ad valorem taxes to be levied on all taxable property within the County. For the prompt payment of principal and interest on the Bonds, the full faith and credit of the County are irrevocably pledged.

The County will furnish upon delivery of the Bonds the approving opinion of Bass, Berry & Sims PLC, Nashville, Tennessee, Bond Counsel to the County, together with the usual closing documents, including a certificate that no litigation is pending affecting the validity of the Bonds. Bidders must use the bid form or forms which, together with the Detailed Notice of Sale and the Preliminary

Official Statement containing pertinent information rel to the issuance, sale and security of the Bonds, may be obtained from the undersigned at the above shown address, or from Sentinel Trust Company, Financial Advisor to the County, 8122 Sawyer Brown Road, Nashville, Tennessee 37221 (615) 662-5129.
